headline: Exchanges Post A $709 Million Outflow As Bitcoin Trades Near 81k
narrative: Crypto exchanges posted a net outflow of $709 million over the past day, equal to 0.263 percent of reserves. That pipe is accumulation: coins left trading venues instead of arriving on them for sale, and that is where the money is going. Bitcoin changed hands near 81k as the inventory moved off exchanges.
author: jordan
